Lux — every screen, dark and light

One font everywhere (the phone's own), every icon sized, and every screen in both modes: the same screen when the phone switches between dark and light. Built from the Lux pages by lux-modes.build.mjs. Welcome and both Sign-in screens have since shipped from their own pages (welcome-ship*.html, signin*-ship-light.html); the Lux drawings of them here are older.
